observations: Board A: comfort panel 1 distinct (hanging corner), panels 2-3 near-duplicate low wavy drapes; congratulation panels 1-2 near-duplicate, panel 3 upright with wider scattered crest; helix built from several loose parallel ribbons.

Board B: supportive three distinct (light low-left with long trailing current; high-centred with horizontal wings; right-of-centre with wavy currents converging from all sides); joy three distinct (upward, all-around, sideways) with a clearly visible red eye ring.
Board A redo: six distinct panels (comfort: hanging corner / low double wave / inward curl; congratulation: slim leaning two-strand / thick many-ribbon wide crest / tall S-wisp).
Video: light anchored and steady; currents sway as a travelling wave, still near the light and freer toward tails; wings undulate over about 3-4 s and slowly widen; tails shed drifting wisps.

implementationGuidance: Three archetypes per family chosen by seed (comfort, congratulation, supportive, joy) plus continuous per-seed jitter, rotation and scale.
Reject repeats: a new composition avoids the previous two compositions' archetypes (bounded session-local memory of composition parameters only).
Supportive currents sway as a travelling wave anchored at the light (from vid-01).
Joy keeps the red iris ring and a sparse eye trace.
Retarget continuity: consecutive compositions hand over particle by particle with a staggered drifting arc over 1.2 s; static draws switch directly.
